title: Father of Mercies, God of Love
description: Father of Mercies, God of Love in Tonic Solfa to ST. PETER, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Ottiwell Heginbotham wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 613 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Praising God in all Changes”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. PETER; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther of mer-cies, God of love, My Fa-ther and my God! I'll sing the hon-ors of thy name; And spread thy praise a-broad.

lines: Father of mercies, God of love,
I'll sing the honors of thy name;
In every period of my life,
Thy mercies gild each transient scene,
In all these mercies may my soul
Nor let the gifts thy grace bestows
Then will I close my eyes in death,
For death itself is life, my God,
If thou art with me there.

licence: Public domain: Ottiwell Heginbotham died in 1768.
credits: Words by Ottiwell Heginbotham (1744–1768), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. PETER by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
